Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for RPKI origin validation：Assets, trust boundaries and test fixtures: Build a ROA table using documentation address space and fictional AS identifiers; evaluate coverage, maxLength and origin to classify valid, invalid and not found. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build a ROA table using documentation address space and fictional AS identifiers; evaluate coverage, maxLength and origin to classify valid, invalid and not found. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。為保留的文件用IP範圍與虛構AS建立ROA表；逐案標示覆蓋前綴、maxLength與origin匹配，分類valid、invalid、not found。 確認每個輸入欄位、測試身分與信任邊界皆已命名；使用合成資料，不連線第三方目標。
steps.observationEn: A receiving role can reproduce acceptance from inputs and identify the owner of residual risks. Build a ROA table using documentation address space and fictional AS identifiers; evaluate coverage, maxLength and origin to classify valid, invalid and not found. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.
steps.failure: 警報消失即宣稱通過，未按本階段判準重新驗證。
steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.

steps.checkEn: Build a ROA table using documentation address space and fictional AS identifiers; evaluate coverage, maxLength and origin to classify valid, invalid and not found. Confirm that every input field, test identity and trust boundary is named; use synthetic data without connecting to third-party targets.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: RPKI路由來源驗證將宣告前綴及來源AS與授權資料比較；它不是完整AS路徑驗證。
knowledge.textEn: RPKI origin validation compares announced prefixes and origin AS with authorization data; it is not full AS-path validation.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 為保留的文件用IP範圍與虛構AS建立ROA表；逐案標示覆蓋前綴、maxLength與origin匹配，分類valid、invalid、not found。
knowledge.textEn: Build a ROA table using documentation address space and fictional AS identifiers; evaluate coverage, maxLength and origin to classify valid, invalid and not found.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 一個/p前綴包含2^(q−p)個/q等長子前綴；允許更長maxLength會增加可被授權的更細前綴，並非增加AS路徑保護。
knowledge.textEn: A /p contains 2^(q−p) equal /q subprefixes; longer maxLength authorizes finer prefixes without adding AS-path protection.
